title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Software Development:
- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.

- Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.

- Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:
- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.

- Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

- Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

- Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.

- Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.

- Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.

- Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

- Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:
- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.

- Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

- Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.

- Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:
- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

- May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.

- Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

- Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

- Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.

- Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:
- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

- Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

- Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:
- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

- Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:
- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:
- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:
- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview
Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 
Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 
Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform.​ 
​​Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. 
​We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.

Responsibilities
​​Lead the design and development of cloud-native backend services for Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, spanning local development, validation, and deployment to production. 
Architect elastic, on-demand compute and environments on Azure that let engineers and AI agents develop and validate changes in isolated, production-like environments at very high concurrency. 
Build distributed, high-throughput services that scale gracefully with an order-of-magnitude growth in change volume driven by agentic development. 
Design deployment services that roll out changes safely and progressively across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with automated health analysis and rollback. 
Build AI agents into the platform itself, for example agents that recover live-site issues and keep changes compliant and secure, so the SDLC runs with minimal human toil and offers similar levels of SLA and reliability guarantees that customers of Fabric get, offered to the developers building on this platform. 
Partner with engineering teams across Fabric to understand their needs, identify dependencies, modernize existing infrastructure for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency, and drive adoption of the platform. 
Write extensible, well-tested, secure, and performant code, primarily in C#/.NET, and review designs and code to raise the engineering quality of the team.​ 
Embody our culture and values 

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications 
​​Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.​ 
Job Requirements: Other & Additional 
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: 
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred hands-on experience building on cloud platform services (Azure or another major cloud), such as compute and containers, storage, messaging, and databases like Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, or Redis. 
Preferred experience designing multi-tenant, high-throughput distributed systems, including scalability, performance, and resilience.

Interest in reinventing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) for AI and agentic software development.​

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

You’ll deliver new product capabilities across our platform, working across the full stack — from database models to UI components — and owning features end-to-end. AI is central to how you’ll work: you’ll use AI-assisted development tools daily to accelerate your output, build AI-powered product experiences for our customers, and help establish the practices that make our team effective in this new operating model.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own features end-to-end: collaborate with Product and Design to define the problem, build the solution, ship it, and monitor it in production

 - Build AI-powered product features — from intelligent data analysis and agent-driven workflows to AI-assisted user experiences that transform how government teams work

 - Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your workflow to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation

 - Produce clean, well-documented code and conduct thorough reviews of both human-written and AI-generated code, with a sharp eye for the subtle failure modes each produces

 - Collaborate across the organization to translate business priorities into shipped features that drive customer success




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Have 12+ years of professional experience building scalable software in an agile environment

 - Have strong experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React or similar) and backend development

 - Are comfortable working across the stack — frontend, backend, data layer — and shipping features end-to-end

 - Have built heavily utilized enterprise SaaS software

 - Actively use AI-assisted development tools and have a feel for when they accelerate you vs. when they lead you astray

 - Have experience building AI-powered product features: agents, AI-driven UX, workflow automation, or retrieval systems (direct ML/model training experience not required)

 - Have built APIs, designed database models (SQL and NoSQL), and worked with event-driven patterns

 - Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where new ideas ship daily, staying closely aligned to customer needs and outcomes

 - Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to improve product experiences

 - A track record of experimenting with new AI tools and bringing effective ones to your team

 - Track record of driving team improvement through mentoring and process innovation

 - Previous work in govtech, fintech, or regulated SaaS environments




OUR STACK

React  ·  TypeScript  ·  Ember.js  ·  Node.js  ·  GraphQL  ·  REST  ·  PostgreSQL  ·  MongoDB  ·  AWS  ·  Azure  ·  Kubernetes  ·  Docker  ·  GitHub




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

title: Staff Software Engineer, GI Team
description:
ABOUT US

Hinge Health is a leader in Digital Physical Therapy, and we’re expanding into new areas of care. In April 2026, we launched our comprehensive Migraine Care Program https://www.hingehealth.com/resources/press-releases/hinge-health-launches-comprehensive-migraine-care-program/, extending our digital care platform beyond physical therapy. We’re now building a new team to launch a Gastrointestinal (GI) Care Program. GI conditions affect roughly one in four U.S. adults and drive $135 billion in annual medical spending.

Our planned acquisition of Cylinder Health https://ir.hingehealth.com/news/news-details/2026/Hinge-Health-to-acquire-Cylinder-Health-expanding-into-gastrointestinal-care/default.aspx, a leader in virtual-first digestive healthcare, gives us a strong foundation for entering this market. By combining Cylinder’s clinical expertise and market presence with Hinge Health’s AI-powered care model and technology platform, we can rapidly build a new GI product expected to launch in 2027.

As a Staff Software Engineer for GI, you’ll help shape an end-to-end digital care experience for people living with GI conditions. You’ll lead rapid experiments to validate assumptions, navigate complex technical and product challenges, and turn what you learn into a reliable, scalable product that can improve members’ health at meaningful scale.

At Hinge Health, staff engineers are senior technical contributors who lead through code, technical judgment, and influence. You’ll set direction for critical systems, contribute to production code daily, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers without moving into people management. You’ll partner closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, Design, and Marketing in San Francisco, Montreal, and Bangalore. Learn more about the staff engineer archetypes https://rnd.hingehealth.com/blog/staff-engineers-at-hinge-health-who-we-hire-who-we-dont that thrive at Hinge Health.



WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

Below are example impact areas over your first 3, 6, and 12 months. At Hinge Health, we regularly adjust priorities to respond to member needs and business incentives, so these are illustrative rather than fixed checklists.

 - In your first 3 months:
   
   - Help define the GI product line from scratch.
   
   - Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, and Marketing to align on the strategy, experimentation roadmap, and success metrics.
   
   - Lead the technical roadmap development for the new GI product line spanning AI systems, UX interfaces, business logic middletier, hardware integration and where to loop in the board-certified clinician for in-person support to members.
   
   - Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts for the hardest parts of the new product line

 - In your first 6 months:
   
   - Build the GI product as a minimum lovable product (MLP) delivering a significant & measurable health improvement for members.
   
   - Mentor and pair with engineers on the pod, helping them grow in engineering best practices, code quality, and experimentation mindset.
   
   - Create engineering best practices for CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and client performance across the entire stack.
   
   - Personally develop the hardest, most challenging software elements in the product roadmap.

 - In your first year:
   
   - Have launched the new product and already work on iterations to adapt it using real member feedback post-launch.
   
   - Drive cross-team initiatives to improve the end-to-end journey for GI end users
   
   - Continuously raise engineering standards on the pod (testing, observability, reliability, accessibility, performance) and help scale the team’s impact as the product and membership grow.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 0->1 Builder: We are looking for an engineer with a track record of building brand new products from scratch.

 - Talent magnet: someone who is recognized as a leader and other people want to work with.

 - AI-Driven development: You have been using the latest AI software development techniques (ex: teams of AI Agents) and continuously look for new AI techniques that can improve your productivity.

 - You move fast, know how to balance innovation vs reuse, and deliver clear business results.

 - Hands-on engineer: You’re reading and writing code across the tech stack (e.g., React Native, BFF/full-stack web, GraphQL, AI Agents, Computer Vision, Medical Device Integration, etc), and you use that fluency to coach, review, and set technical direction.

 - Experiment-driven operator: You think in terms of hypotheses, sample sizes, and decision rules, and you can run a dense A/B experimentation roadmap without sacrificing quality.

 - Team mentor and collaborator: You enjoy leveling up a strong but more junior team through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and clear written communication.

 - Owner mindset: You think in terms of systems and business impact, not just tickets—you’re comfortable taking a problem from idea through launch, measurement, and iteration.

 - Inclusive team builder: You create clear expectations, give direct feedback, and foster a culture where engineers can do the best work of their careers.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - A minimum of 8+ years of practical software engineering experience, including building and shipping user-facing applications in production.

 - A minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or foreign equivalent).

 - 2+ years of hands-on React Native experience building mobile applications at scale.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Technologies: Experience building in large React Native codebases, TypeScript/Node.js & Go backends, GraphQL, AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, SNS, SageMaker), tooling for client performance, render optimization, devops and app architecture patterns.

 - Product Integration mindset: History operating a product surface that integrates across multiple platforms owned by different teams.

 - Track record of running experiments (e.g., A/B tests or multivariate tests) on core product surfaces and using results to drive roadmap decisions.

 - Strong proficiency with TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native, and modern mobile development tooling; familiarity with backend services (e.g., Node/TypeScript, GraphQL, or similar) is a plus.

 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design collaboration, and technical guidance.

 - Comfort collaborating with product, design, and data/analytics partners to define metrics, interpret results, and refine experiences.

 - Experience developing consumer-facing apps used by millions/billions of users.

 - Regulated environments: Experience working within healthcare (HIPAA) or other highly regulated domains involving sensitive member data.
   


HINGE HEALTH HYBRID MODEL

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

 


ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com.

CULTURE & ENGAGEMENT

We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com" emails. As a Full-Stack Engineer you will design, develop, and maintain software systems to build secure, efficient, and reliable software that meets business needs. You will collaborate with product, engineering and delivery teams to define functional and non-functional requirements and implement end-to-end solutions. You will regularly mentor peers, contribute to engineering standards and reusable patterns, working both independently as well as a part of a global team.

- Create and document designs for custom full-stack software applications or components, spanning front-end, back-end, APIs, and data storage.

- Contribute to the development of solution architectures in business, infrastructure, or functional areas.

- Partner with global cross-functional teams to plan, execute and release in an Agile setup and deliver within matrix organization.
-

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field
- 7 to 11 years of hands-on experience working in full-stack development

Required Skills:
 
- Web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, HTTP, REST APIs
- Full-stack development: experience building web applications (front end, back end and data)
- Frontend technologies like Angular, React
- Databases: SQL and relational database design (plus practical query optimisation)
- Programming: proficiency in at least one major stack (TypeScript/Node/React, Python)
- AWS cloud: building and operating services on AWS, with sound security and compliance practices. DevOps: Git, CI/CD, containers (Docker) and infrastructure as code; strong observability mindset
- Ways of working: Agile/Scrum, code reviews, test-driven development and strong stakeholder collaboration

Primary Skills (Must have):

- Python
- Full Stack Development
- React
- AWS Cloud
- REST APIs
- SQL / Relational Databases
- CI/CD
- Docker
- Git
- Agile/Scrum

Secondary Skills (Nice to have):
 
- AWS certifications and experience with cloud-native patterns (serverless, event-driven, microservices)
- Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and secure data integrations 
- UX and design thinking exposure; accessibility and performance best practices (check for UX experience)
- Experience working with globally distributed teams across time zones

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What we look for:
 
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
Tech Engineering Lead

Role snapshot

Title

Tech Engineering Lead

Location

Bengaluru, on-site

Reports to

Head of Engineering

Experience

6 to 8 years in software engineering, at least 2 as a technical lead

Type

Full-time, hands-on (most of your time in code and architecture)

Open items before publishing: confirm work mode, compensation band and ESOPs.

About TalkingLands

TalkingLands is a Bengaluru-based prop tech and AI startup, founded in 2021. We turn land records, cad astral maps, regulatory rules and satellite data into property intelligence that developers, lenders and buyers use to make land decisions. We already work with leading developers such as Prestige, and have more than 50,000 active users.

The engineering problem is hard and genuine. We hold millions of land parcels as spatial polygons, map every property address to a location, and answer questions about containment (which village, zone or jurisdiction a parcel falls in), proximity (what lies within a regulatory buffer) and overlap (which restrictions touch a boundary). Answers must be traceable to a source record, because customers make purchases and lending decisions on them.

Our platform is built on patented spatial intelligence. Technology and deep integration with Karnataka’s regulatory and cad astral systems.

The role

This is a purely technical role in our engineering team. You will lead the architecture and code behind our AI and spatial platform, and make sure it stays fast and reliable as our data and users grow.

You write production code every week, set the technical direction, and own the quality, performance and reliability of everything we ship. If you love going deep on AI systems, databases and scalable architecture, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

AI systems

- Design and build AI pipelines for document extraction using self-hosted small language models.
- Build Agentic workflows and MCP-based tools on top of our spatial and property data.
- Keep deterministic logic (registry lookups, spatial operations, regulatory calculations) separate from language-model steps, so every output can be cited and corrected.
- Measure and improve model accuracy, latency and cost in production.

Scalable platform

- Design services, APIs and data models for spatial and document workloads, and write production code in them.
- Keep spatial queries fast at scale: indexing, query plans, tile generation and caching.
- Scale the platform for millions of parcels and a fast-growing user base without losing speed or reliability.
- Review significant pull requests for correctness, clarity and performance.

Quality and operations

- Own test strategy, CI/CD pipelines and release quality.
- Own production health: monitoring, on-call, incident response and postmortems.
- Build security and audit requirements (access control, logging, data handling) into the architecture, not after it.
- Track and pay down technical debt.

Must have

- 6 to 8 years building and running production software, with at least 2 years as a technical lead.
- Strong backend engineering in TypeScript (Node.js) or Python, including API design and service boundaries.
- Deep PostgreSQL experience: schema design, indexing, query plan tuning and migrations on tables with millions of rows.
- Hands-on experience building with language models in production, such as document extraction, retrieval or agents.
- Has designed and scaled systems that ran in production for years, and can explain the trade-offs made.
- Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD, enough to debug a failed deploy yourself.
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or computer science, or equivalent experience.

Good to have

- PostGIS and spatial operations: point-in-polygon, buffers, intersections, coordinate reference systems.
- Vector tile pipelines (Tippecanoe, PMTiles) and web map rendering with MapLibre GL JS.
- Agentic workflows, tool use and MCP.
- Self-hosting, serving or fine-tuning small language models.
- Exposure to land records, cad astral data or real estate due diligence in India.
- Experience working under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.
- GitOps deployment with ArgoCD.

Tech stack

Layer

What we use

Data

PostgreSQL with PostGIS as the system of record

Map delivery

Static PMTiles built with ogr2ogr and Tippecanoe, served over CDN

Frontend

TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS

Services

TypeScript and Python

AI

Self-hosted small language models for document extraction, MCP, Agentic workflows

Platform

Kubernetes, ArgoCD, CI/CD pipelines

Why join us?

- Purely technical work: AI, spatial data and scalable systems, nothing else on your plate.
- A hard, unsolved problem: making India’s land data reliable enough to buy and lend on.
- Real users at real scale: leading developers like Prestige, and more than 50,000 active users.
- Ownership of the architecture from day one, and technical challenges that grow as we grow.

If you love hard technical problems in AI and scalable systems, we would love to hear from you. Send your resume and a short note on a system you designed and what you would do differently today. Application email to be added.

General

- Strong backend development experience with Python, Java, Node.js, C#, or similar technologies.

- Experience building secure applications using authentication and authorization frameworks, preferably Microsoft Entra ID.
- Strong understanding of application architecture, scalability, security, reliability, and performance.

title: Senior Software Engineer Specialist
description:
Esko | Veralto Corporation Location: Bangalore, India – Hybrid

About The Role

The Opportunity

We're seeking a Software Engineer Specialist to design, build, and deliver artwork automation and structured content solutions for WebCenter. In this hands-on role, you'll independently own features that connect structured content and artwork workflows with Adobe InDesign and related creative applications. The emphasis is on JavaScript/TypeScript, React interfaces, and API integration, working closely with Adobe integration engineers on the complete user workflow. You'll apply sound engineering judgment and help the team adopt AI-assisted development responsibly. This is an opportunity to deepen your technical skills and grow your career at the intersection of creative technology and purposeful engineering.

You'll work closely with product managers, architects, UX designers, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions. Success in this role means delivering complex features predictably, improving quality measurably, and becoming a trusted technical resource for the team within 12–18 months.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

- Design, develop, test, and maintain WebCenter artwork automation and structured content capabilities, with emphasis on JavaScript/TypeScript, React interfaces, and API integration; contribute to Adobe InDesign scripting and integration workflows as you build domain knowledge, collaborating on Java/J2EE services as needed.
- Own and deliver complex features, enhancements, and technical initiatives independently from requirements clarification and design through implementation, automated testing, release, and follow-up; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks proactively.
- Translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-quality technical solutions for artwork automation and structured content workflows, preserving content accuracy and traceability from source content to generated artwork.
- Collaborate across teams to identify, manage, and resolve dependencies that impact delivery timelines and product quality.
- Design reliable integrations and automation with clear API/data contracts, input validation, actionable error reporting, and safe handling of timeouts, retries, and partial failures; consider performance, security, and compatibility across supported application versions.
- Work with UX designers and domain experts to deliver clear, usable artwork and content-editing workflows; test content mapping and generated outputs against representative documents, templates, and edge cases.
- Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture and implementation decisions that drive long-term product health.
- Articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to build shared understanding.
- Contribute to AI-powered application capabilities within WebCenter that improve artwork automation and structured content workflows where required by the product roadmap.
- Explore agent-based solutions, intelligent workflows, and AI-assisted product experiences where appropriate, in collaboration with architects and relevant specialists.
- Use approved AI-enabled development tools to assist with coding, test generation, refactoring, documentation, and investigation; independently review and validate outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, and protection of proprietary or customer data.
- Support fellow engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing to build a high-performing team.
- Promote engineering best practices, continuous learning, maintainability, and software quality across the R&D organization.

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For

These are the must-have requirements for the role:

- Proven, substantial hands-on experience in front-end web or full-stack software development, including production React applications, with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering and maintaining complex features in an established software product.
- Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, including component design, state management, and asynchronous user-interface development; ability and willingness to learn Adobe ExtendScript and InDesign integration. Prior Adobe application or scripting experience is not required.
- Strong JavaScript fundamentals, including asynchronous programming, modular design, error handling, and debugging; sound software design principles and practical understanding of HTTP, browser behaviour, and client/server interactions.
- Experience integrating web applications with external systems through HTTP/REST APIs, including authentication, data exchange, error handling, and troubleshooting across client/server boundaries; familiarity with automated testing, code reviews, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience translating UX designs into accessible, responsive, reusable UI components, including loading, empty, validation, and error states; ability to investigate browser performance and compatibility issues.
- Proven ability to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions across the full software development lifecycle.
- Proven ability to diagnose complex defects using logs, browser developer tools, debugging, and profiling; improve existing code safely through automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, regression protection, and incremental refactoring.
- Proven ability to write maintainable JavaScript scripts or automation and adapt solutions across different scripting runtimes.
- Ability to take ownership under ambiguity, clarify requirements, make proportionate technical decisions, and escalate risks early while collaborating effectively across teams.
- Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to clearly articulate technical decisions, trade-offs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

These skills will set candidates apart:

- Proven hands-on technical experience with Adobe Creative Cloud applications, especially InDesign, including ExtendScript scripting and Adobe application APIs/object models; experience with InDesign Server integration is also valuable.
- Experience with InDesign Server automation and APIs, Adobe Illustrator, or Adobe extensibility frameworks such as CEP and/or UXP, with awareness of host-application and version compatibility.
- Familiarity with C++-based Adobe plug-in development as a complementary skill for WebCenter integration and Adobe application workflows.
- Experience with XML and structured content formats, including content modelling, parsing, validation, and transformation; relevant examples include XPath, XSLT, XML Schema (XSD), or InDesign Markup Language (IDML). Expertise in every listed format or technology is not required.
- Experience with template-driven publishing, content-to-layout mapping, multilingual content, or artwork/prepress workflows.
- Experience with Java/J2EE services, relational databases and SQL, or additional scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
- Experience modernizing established enterprise applications incrementally while preserving compatibility, security, and customer workflows.
- Experience designing and implementing AI-powered application capabilities, or integrating AI services into creative or enterprise software products.
- Familiarity with AI application patterns such as tool integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and workflow orchestration.
- Proven experience using AI-assisted development tools in real engineering work, with concrete examples of improved productivity or quality and critical validation of generated outputs.
- Experience working in Agile software development environments.

About Esko

It's all possible with a role at Esko . Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About Veralto

Esko is proud to be part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

description:

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About Your Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Senior Technical Lead to architect, design, and oversee the development of scalable web applications and distributed systems. The ideal candidate brings strong backend expertise in Python (FastAPI preferred) or Java, combined with solid frontend development experience using ReactJS and TypeScript.

This role will lead the design and delivery of end-to-end systems—from user-facing applications to backend services and cloud infrastructure. You will guide engineering teams, drive architectural decisions, and ensure best practices across the full software development lifecycle.

Experience leveraging AI tools and building AI-driven solutions will be a significant advantage, especially for developing intelligent features, automation, and data-driven capabilities within products.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership

- Lead the architecture and design of full-stack applications, including frontend interfaces, backend services, and cloud infrastructure.
- Provide hands-on technical guidance to engineering teams and mentor developers across frontend and backend domains.
- Define coding standards, enforce code quality, and conduct thorough code reviews.
- Drive end-to-end delivery, from architecture and development to deployment and maintenance.

Backend Engineering & API Development

- Architect and build backend services using Python/FastAPI (preferred) or Java (Spring Boot/Quarkus).
- Design and implement scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs with a strong focus on performance, security, and maintainability.
- Build asynchronous processing pipelines and microservices using tools like Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis, or similar message brokers.
- Design efficient database schemas and queries using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases.
- Implement caching strategies and optimise backend services for high throughput and reliability.

Frontend Development

- Develop modern web applications using ReactJS and TypeScript.
- Design reusable UI components and scalable frontend architecture.
- Implement state management, API integrations, and responsive user interfaces.
- Collaborate closely with design and product teams to deliver intuitive user experiences.
- Ensure frontend applications maintain high standards of performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Cloud & DevOps

- Deploy, manage, and optimise applications on AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
- Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and environment provisioning.
- Use Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and microservice orchestration.
- Ensure system observability through logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing.

Architecture & System Design

- Lead discussions on scalability, distributed architecture, caching strategies, and event-driven patterns.
- Design full-stack solutions that balance performance, reliability, and user experience.
- Drive adoption of cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices.
- Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance standards.

AI & Intelligent Systems (Advantage)

- Leverage modern AI tools and frameworks to enhance developer productivity and product capabilities.
- Contribute to or lead the development of AI-powered features, such as intelligent search, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, or automation tools.
- Work with technologies such as LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG pipelines where relevant.
- Evaluate opportunities to integrate AI-driven capabilities into existing products and workflows.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
- 10-13 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership role.
- Strong expertise in:
- Python (FastAPI preferred) OR Java
- ReactJS and TypeScript
- REST and GraphQL API development
- Asynchronous processing (Celery or similar)
- AWS cloud services
- Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization
- Solid understanding of:
- Microservices architectures
- Distributed systems design
- SQL and NoSQL databases
- CI/CD pipelines
- Monitoring and observability frameworks

Nice to Have

- Experience building AI-driven applications or integrating AI capabilities into products.
- Experience with event-driven systems such as Kafka, SNS/SQS.
- Exposure to Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and clean architecture principles.
- Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).
- Experience with performance tuning, load testing, and AWS cost optimization.

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management abilities.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.
- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, agile environment.

About The Role

We're hiring an experienced Sr.SDE for our Industries team within Special Projects. The team turns our core platform into purpose-built solutions for specific verticals, such as restaurants, healthcare, real estate, automotive, home services, and fitness.

As an Sr.SDE, you'll build frontend-heavy full stack features that make our platform feel native to each industry. That means rich, interactive interfaces like floor plans, booking and scheduling views, industry dashboards, and guided setup flows. It also means configurable UI that adapts to each vertical's data models and workflows. You'll own the experience end-to-end, from component design to the APIs behind it, making sound technical trade-offs across UX, performance, scalability, and maintainability, while working closely with product, design, domain experts, and core platform teams.

This role suits someone who cares about polished, fast, intuitive interfaces, is comfortable owning the backend that supports them, learns new domains quickly, and uses AI tools to work faster and better.

What You'll Do

- Build rich, interactive industry experiences in Vue 3 and TypeScript, such as visual floor-plan editors, scheduling and resource views, dashboards, and multi-step onboarding flows

- Lead the technical design of frontend-heavy features, turn product and design concepts into high-quality interfaces, and shape the UX with designers and domain experts
- Evaluate frontend and full stack architectural trade-offs, balancing experimentation speed, user experience, performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability as solutions mature
- Own frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile web, including views used live by staff on shared devices
- Build and extend the APIs behind your features using Node.js/NestJS, with Firestore, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis as data layers
- Handle real-time and async UI states, such as live updates, optimistic updates, background job status, and conflict handling
- Work with core platform and app teams to reuse and improve shared components and design system patterns
- Own the full development lifecycle for significant features and initiatives: technical design, building, testing, deploying, measuring, and maintaining. 
- Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, sharing learnings and helping raise engineering quality across the team 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend architecture and complex web applications
- Deep expertise in Vue (Vue 3 preferred) or a comparable modern framework, plus TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Experience building complex interactive UI, such as drag-and-drop, canvas or SVG rendering, calendars and timelines, or data-dense dashboards
- Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization
- Solid backend skills to work end-to-end: API design, data modeling, and Node.js (NestJS a plus)
- Experience with real-time data, async workflows, and keeping UI state consistent with backend state
- A strong eye for UX, accessibility, and detail, with the ability to make good product decisions when specs are incomplete
- Openness to using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up development and improve code quality
- Curiosity about how different industries work, and comfort learning from non-technical domain experts

Bonus Points

- Experience with canvas libraries like Konva, Fabric.js, or PixiJS
- Experience building design systems or shared component libraries
- Experience with metadata-driven or schema-driven UI, such as form builders, custom objects, or configurable layouts
- Background in vertical SaaS or industry-specific products, such as restaurant POS, booking, healthcare, or real estate tools
- Familiarity with GCP services like Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub
- Experience with frontend testing (unit, component, and end-to-end, e.g. Playwright)

Why Join Us?

- You'll shape what our platform looks and feels like for entire industries, often building the first screen a new vertical's customers see
- You'll build interfaces that business owners and their staff use live, every day, to run their operations
- You'll join a small, high-leverage team that values product thinking, craft, and moving fast with confidence, including using AI to build smarter

Build AI-powered internal platforms that ETS runs on, from the database to the UI, and make them observable in production.

What Makes This Role Exciting
You will work with product owners, infrastructure owners, and partner engineers to turn ambiguous, high-impact problems into clean solutions. You'll own products that ETS teams depend on every day. The role mixes product engineering with hands-on integration work. You may start closer to one than the other, and you should be comfortable moving between them as the work changes.

Strong full-stack engineers who have owned work through production, have built something with LLMs or agents, can design securely and for scale, and want to grow into leading designs and mentoring others.

Responsibilities
- Own features and integrations from design to production for an enterprise web application: data model, services, APIs, and an accessible UI

- Operate what you ship: define SLIs and SLOs, instrument with metrics, logs, and traces, build dashboards and alerts, and join on-call
- Partner with product owners, infrastructure teams, and engineering peers to scope problems and prototype solutions quickly
- Present your designs in design reviews, take part in reviewing others' work, and help teammates grow through code reviews and pairing

Minimum Qualifications
- B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years of professional software development, with a track record of owning features or integrations through production
- Full-stack experience: a backend language such as Java (Spring Boot or similar) and a modern web UI framework such as React or Angular
- Experience designing features with security principles (threat modeling, authentication and authorization, least privilege, secure data handling) and scalable patterns (stateless services, caching, asynchronous messaging, retries, circuit breakers, back-pressure), and explaining your trade-offs in design reviews
- Have built an LLM- or agent-based feature, whether in production, as a prototype, or as a significant project, and can describe how you designed it and evaluated its reliability

- Secure software practices: security design reviews, dependency and vulnerability management, compliance
- Experience leading a project or mentoring other engineers, and contributing to inner-source or open-source projects

About Altura

Altura is an AI technology partner for companies that want technology to work inside their operation, not alongside it.

We start by understanding the business. Before proposing anything, we map how the company actually runs: its processes, its systems, its data, and where the operational load sits. The goal is to find where technology has real leverage, and where it doesn't.

We build the roadmap. Opportunities are prioritized by return, effort and dependencies, each one with defined scope, estimated investment, and the indicator it is meant to move. The company ends up knowing what to do first, what it costs, and how success will be measured.

We implement. Custom software when existing tools don't cover what the operation needs. Automations that connect systems and remove manual work. AI agents that analyze information, decide and execute tasks within a process. And the infrastructure that makes all of it run reliably. We are not tied to a predefined solution — we choose the technology each business priority calls for.

One team, from strategy through implementation and beyond. That is the whole point: technology projects usually break at the handoff, so we don't hand off.

title: SDE2 - Full Stack
description:
About The Role

We're hiring two backend-heavy full-stack engineers (SDE 2 or SDE 3) for the Cowork team at Sarvam. Cowork is the agentic side of Indus: users hand it real work, and an agent plans, uses tools and connectors, works in a cloud sandbox, and hands back files, docs and artifacts across web, Android, iOS, macOS and Windows.

The role is full stack, but the centre of gravity is the backend: the BFF that every client talks to, and increasingly the agent harness behind it. You'll ship features end to end, from the API and data model through to the client screens on mobile, desktop and web.

What You'll Work On

Most of your time goes into the BFF and the services around it; the rest into client work and the harness, depending on what the roadmap needs that quarter.

- BFF (Chat Service): design and own the APIs that web, mobile and desktop share: sessions, conversations, streaming turns, artifacts, connectors, custom and managed agents. Data modelling, migrations, auth and RBAC, pagination and search. 
- Real-time streaming: stream LLM output, tool calls and agent events from the harness to clients over an event bus, and keep it correct under reconnects, retries and partial failures. 
- Agent harness and platform: contribute to Panja, our agent harness: tool and MCP integrations, sandboxed execution, file and artifact flows, latency and token-cost work. 
- Clients: build features end to end on our Kotlin/Compose Multiplatform apps (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows) and the Next.js web app, so a feature you design in the backend reaches users on every surface. 
- Production ownership: observability, on-call, RCAs, and making the system faster and cheaper with numbers to back it. 

Tech stack

Python and PostgreSQL are the core; you don't need every item below on day one.

- Backend: Python, SQLAlchemy + Alembic, PostgreSQL, OpenAPI
- Supporting services: Go
- Mobile and desktop: Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows)
- Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript

What We're Looking For

A strong backend engineer who has also shipped real frontend work and is happy to keep doing both.

- 3+ years (SDE 2) or 5+ years (SDE 3) building and running production backend services. 
- Deep in at least one backend language; Python preferred, Go, Kotlin/JVM or TypeScript/Node also welcome. 
- Solid API and data-model design: REST/streaming APIs, PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, indexing, transactions. 
- Distributed-systems fundamentals: async processing, queues or event streams, idempotency, retries, failure handling. 
- Production experience on Kubernetes or a similar platform, with observability you actually used to debug an incident. 
- Has shipped user-facing features on at least one client platform: Android, iOS, desktop or web (React/Next.js). Kotlin/Compose experience is a plus, not a gate. 
- Willing to pick up the side of the stack they know less, and to learn agent and LLM systems on the job. 
- Clear written communication: design docs, PR descriptions, RCAs. 

Nice to have

- Built on LLM APIs: tool calling, streaming, prompt caching, evals, or an agent loop of your own. 
- MCP servers or clients, OAuth connector integrations, or sandboxed code execution. 
- Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform, or native Android/iOS. 
- Real-time systems: WebSockets/SSE, NATS, Kafka, or Temporal-style durable workflows. 
- Go services, or performance and cost work with measurable before/after numbers. 
- Open-source work or public writing we can read.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers.

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare.

About R1 RCM

R1 RCM is a leading provider of technology-driven solutions that improve the patient experience and financial performance of healthcare providers. In India, our teams work across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai to make healthcare simpler through technology, operational expertise, and innovation. Our inclusive culture values different perspectives, continuous learning, accountability, and high-quality outcomes for customers and patients.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior R&D Engineer to join our India-based R&D team. This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI/ML, cloud-native architecture, and rapid experimentation. You will take ambiguous business or healthcare problems from discovery through proof of concept and production-ready implementation, while raising the technical, quality, and engineering standards of the team.

You will serve as an in-house technical and functional expert for the team’s problem space, understand how services and data flows interact, and work with product, engineering, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to build reusable, secure, observable, and scalable solutions.

What You Will Do

- Own the end-to-end delivery of R&D initiatives, from problem framing, feasibility analysis, experimentation, and architecture through implementation, demonstration, transition, and measurable outcome tracking. 
- Design and build production-grade AI-enabled and enterprise applications using Python and/or C#/.NET, modern APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, and suitable frontend technologies such as React or Angular.
- Apply machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and intelligent workflow patterns where they create demonstrable business value.
- Architect cloud-native solutions on Azure and/or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, managed data services, messaging, secure identity, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
- Decompose complex, ambiguous problems into small, testable, and independently deliverable components; select pragmatic approaches based on value, risk, cost, latency, accuracy, and operability.
- Design secure integration patterns and APIs for enterprise systems, relational and NoSQL data stores, model services, and high-volume or asynchronous workloads.
- Write production-ready, testable, maintainable code; lead meaningful refactoring; review pull requests; and eliminate recurring classes of defects through improved design and engineering practices. 
- Drive automated testing, observability, performance measurement, security-by-design, model evaluation, and operational readiness across team solutions. 
- Proactively identify execution gaps, technical risks, dependencies, and scaling constraints, then propose and implement practical mitigations with minimal guidance. 
- Build reusable accelerators, reference implementations, design patterns, technical documentation, and implementation guides that improve delivery across the R&D and broader engineering organization. 
- Coach engineers, share knowledge, support technical hiring, and influence adoption of engineering-wide standards and initiatives without relying on formal authority. 
- Communicate findings, trade-offs, outcomes, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

- Typically 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on ownership of complex solutions; experience leading technical delivery within a team is expected. 
- Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or both, with sound knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean architecture, data structures, and software engineering fundamentals. 
- Hands-on experience delivering AI/ML solutions using frameworks or services such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, or equivalent platforms. 
- Practical experience with generative AI and LLM-based systems, including prompt and context design, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, grounding, safety, latency, and cost considerations. 
- Experience with NLP and unstructured data processing. Exposure to document intelligence, computer vision, conversational AI, or intelligent workflow automation is strongly relevant. 
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and building distributed, microservices-based, or event-driven applications. 
- Cloud engineering experience on Azure and/or GCP, including cloud-native design, containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. 
- Strong working knowledge of SQL and data modeling, plus experience with at least one NoSQL, search, vector, cache, or messaging technology. 
- Demonstrated use of automated testing, code review, logging, monitoring, tracing, performance optimization, and secure software development practices. 
- Ability to operate independently, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, manage shifting R&D priorities, and convert experiments into reliable engineering outcomes. 
- Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management, clinical or insurance documents, EHR integrations, or high-volume transaction systems. 
- Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory practices, including HIPAA and applicable data-protection requirements. 
- Full-stack development experience . 
- Experience with broker/message-bus patterns, CQRS, ports-and-adapters, hexagonal or onion architecture, service-oriented architecture, and resilient distributed-system design. 
- Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS and to infrastructure-as-code practices such as Terraform. 
- Experience with MLOps or LLMOps, model and prompt evaluation, experiment tracking, model monitoring, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI controls. 
- Experience with analytics or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. 

Success in This Role

- R&D ideas are converted into validated, reusable capabilities with clear evidence of technical feasibility and business value. 
- Solutions are secure, observable, testable, cost-aware, and designed for a credible path from proof of concept to production. 
- The team executes with greater clarity and fewer recurring defects because of stronger architecture, reusable components, automation, and technical coaching. 
- Stakeholders receive honest, concise, and evidence-based communication about risks, options, progress, and outcomes. 
- The engineer becomes a trusted domain expert who anticipates change, identifies opportunities, and improves outcomes for customers and patients. 

Level Expectations

- Independence: Proactively solves complex problems and drives delivery with minimal guidance. 
- Scope: Influences the team’s services, architecture, delivery practices, and adjacent technical domains. 
- Impact: Improves business outcomes, solution reliability, engineering effectiveness, and the team’s ability to execute. 
- Leadership: Coaches peers, leads project groups through influence, creates space for diverse input, and helps the team adopt broader engineering initiatives. 
- Quality and security: Owns a team-level quality mindset and actively partners with security and platform stakeholders on standards and upcoming changes. 

How We Work

At R1, we anticipate change, identify better ways to serve customers and patients, and hold ourselves accountable for high-quality outcomes. We build connections across teams, value different perspectives, share what we learn, act with integrity, and proactively solve problems for ourselves and others.

Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests.

Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package. To learn more, visit: r1rcm.com

Visit us on Facebook

This role brings deep expertise in the science and engineering of intelligent systems and is responsible for making AI reliable, measurable, scalable, and useful in production. The role also defines and leads the AI and agent platforms that serve as the company-wide harness for non-AI engineers building AI and agentic applications.

Responsibilities

- Define technical strategy and architecture for large-scale LLM, agent, retrieval, and AI platforms at the company level. 
- Establish reusable patterns for agent graphs, MCPs, orchestration, state management, memory, context engineering, tool use, and multi-agent systems. 
- Define standards for prompting, model selection, routing, structured outputs, guardrails, and failure recovery.

- Lead the design and adoption of AWS AI capabilities, including Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore. 
- Define evaluation methodologies and quality standards for AI systems, including offline evaluations, online metrics, human review, regression testing, and production feedback loops. 
- Establish observability standards for agent traces, tool calls, state transitions, memory access, model behavior, latency, cost, and failures. 
- Drive technical decisions related to reliability, security, privacy, governance, performance, and responsible AI.

- Build reusable AI platforms, frameworks, and engineering practices that enable software engineers to develop AI applications effectively. 
- Identify high-leverage opportunities to apply AI to customer and business problems. 
- Influence product and engineering roadmaps through deep technical expertise and business context. 
- Mentor AI engineers and software engineers working on AI-enabled products. 
- Resolve ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges and unblock multiple teams. 
- Communicate AI architecture, tradeoffs, limitations, and technical strategy clearly to engineering and business stakeholders. 

Qualifications

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Postgres & Python)
description:
About us
We’re the team behind Ikka Dukka, a Delhi-based premium gifting and lifestyle brand. We’ve delivered corporate campaigns of 1 to 20,000+ pieces for companies in banking, finance, tech and real estate.
Out of that work we’re building a separate B2B software platform. A working version is built and being prepared for its first corporate clients. It was built quickly with AI coding tools, and it works. We now need an engineer to take it over, make it solid and launch it.
The platform lets companies run recurring and large-scale gifting programmes end to end: recipient data, gift selection, orders, inventory, dispatch tracking, exceptions and reporting. For clients, it saves money (less admin, fewer failed deliveries, less waste) and makes money (programmes that keep customers and employees engaged, and data on what works). Full product details are shared with shortlisted candidates under NDA.
The role
You’ll own the platform’s technology. Not a list of tickets: the technical roadmap, the weak spots, what to fix, what to leave alone and what to build next.
This isn’t a role for an “AI expert.” The value is in the data and workflow. We need a strong engineer who uses AI coding tools every day to move fast, and who can tell when generated code is insecure, inefficient or simply wrong. Some features call an LLM, so you’ll need to ship those safely. No machine-learning background is needed.
The stack is a React and Python platform on Postgres, with a lot of logic in the database itself.
You’ll work directly with our product owner (co-founder), an experienced technical advisor who reviews architecture and security at key points, and the founders and operations team. No layers of management.
What you’ll work on first
- Getting to know the platform and making it secure and reliable, including fixing the biggest risks in security, data handling and testing
- Setting up proper testing and staging, and proving the platform works at real campaign volumes
- Getting it ready to launch with our first corporate clients, including keeping each client’s data separate
Ongoing
- Own the technical roadmap and drive development without waiting to be told
- Turn business needs into practical technical solutions
- Build and ship across backend, database, frontend and integrations (couriers, Shopify, client data files)
- Run the system in production: hosting, backups, monitoring, fixing issues
- Keep client data separate and secure, in line with India’s DPDP Act
- Keep the codebase clean and documented, so a second engineer could join without a rewrite
Must have
- 3–6 years building, shipping and running web applications with real users (exceptional candidates outside this range considered)
- Deep PostgreSQL: row-level security, database functions, and migrations on a live database without losing data. This is the most important skill for the role
- Strong backend development, API integrations and modern deployment; Python a plus
- Comfortable building frontend screens in React
- You’ve owned a product or major system, not just worked on tickets inside one
- You’ve debugged production failures and can explain what went wrong
- You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily, and know when not to trust them
- Sound security judgement: authentication, permissions, secrets, customer data
- Multi-tenant experience, or a clear understanding of how to keep each client’s data separate
- You’d rather improve an existing codebase than rewrite it, and you’re comfortable working without someone reviewing every change
- Clear communication with non-technical people
Particularly valuable
- Supabase or FastAPI experience
- Shipping LLM features in production: cost limits, prompt injection, what data goes to the provider
- B2B SaaS; Shopify, logistics or CRM integrations
- Enterprise security reviews, data-protection compliance, or regulated clients such as banks
- Early-stage startup experience
Apply with your CV, links to things you’ve built, and a short note on how you use AI tools, including one time the AI got it wrong.
Location based in Delhi.
